title: Bluff or Bounty: Cowboy Bebop True or False
description: Ten statements on the studio, the credits, the setting, the score and the channels. Some are one detail off, so read closely.

questions.question: Sunrise made the series, with Shinichirō Watanabe leading the team as director.
The credited creator Hajime Yatate is one novelist whose book Sunrise adapted.
The credited creator Hajime Yatate is a shared pen name for the Sunrise staff, not one person.
Bones made the series, with Shinichirō Watanabe leading the team as director.
The series is a single season of 26 episodes, which the show calls sessions.
In 2031 a crew of bounty hunters chase criminals around the Solar System from a ship called the Bebop.
The series is a single season of 52 episodes, which the show calls sessions.
In 2071 a crew of bounty hunters chase criminals around the Solar System from a ship called the Bebop.
Yoko Kanno scored the show in a jazz-heavy style and formed the band Seatbelts to play it.
Satellite channel Wowow aired the show first, from 3 April to 26 June 1998, before the full run reached TV Tokyo.
